text: Required by S7.5 review finding 1 (2026-10-04): the preview stamp must carry a recipe/plan digest for drafts. Today previewCounting and previewRows take only an AnalysisRevision, and a draft's RunStamp has plan=Unbound and input=Unbound, so nothing on the wire says which recipe the backend prepared. The backend's StalePreview/TamperedPreview cannot catch a recipe change, and Save & run could submit an old design labelled as the new one. The real backend must bind the preview to the prepared plan's digest and refuse a mismatch.
